set.body:
Complete the constitutional migration without losing existing numerical or platform guarantees.

Acceptance:
- Route legacy raw-matrix and separate-metric entry points through the new semantic graph or deprecate them with explicit compatibility policies.
- Preserve sparse and affine MatrixView behavior and prohibit accidental densification.
- Preserve public projection behavior where mathematically valid; document renamed GPCA quantities and migration mappings.
- Update modules/multivar/README.md, root README.md, docs/module-relations.md, and a durable architecture plan.
- Document safe versus Unsafe constructors, certificate invalidation, singular policies, alignment evidence, and the IR boundary.
- Run sbt multivarJVM/test and multivarJS/test.
- Run sbt compileAll and testAll.
- Run git diff --check and dependency scans proving shared multivar remains free of Breeze, dataset, image, scheduler, and binding dependencies.
- Confirm law and conformance tests use explicit norms, absolute tolerances, and relative tolerances.
- Record final unsupported or deferred items, including learned alignment and gauge-sensitive shape estimators.
set.title: multivar constitution: compatibility migration, documentation, and release gate
